pose: A strict side-profile view capturing the full horizontal length and mass of the giant short-necked pliosaur as it swims steadily from left to right. The entire animal is aligned parallel to the frame boundaries to cleanly track along the central UI measuring tape interface. Its large triangular skull, thick compact body, and all four large paddle-flippers are fully extended horizontally to maximize the wide layout mapping.

morphology_overrides.neck: Thick, powerful, and extremely short; appears as a seamless horizontal transition from the massive head straight into the torso, with its limited length clearly measurable in profile view.
morphology_overrides.skull: Massive, elongated triangular head with a heavy, reinforced lower jaw, shown in profile view parallel to the frame edge, taking up nearly 1/4 of the animal's total body length.
morphology_overrides.body: Barrel-chested and robust; designed for high-mass momentum, spanning horizontally across the card layout.
morphology_overrides.patterning: Mottled grey and silver 'scumbled' texture to create a sense of ancient, weathered skin along the full expansive horizontal flank.
morphology_overrides.negative_prompt: long neck, slender neck, flexible neck, small head, vertical orientation, angled view
